notes: Source is the maker's current machine-tool site www.wiamachine.com (WIA MACHINE TOOLS; linked from en.hyundai-wia.com machine-tool page). Data read from its public JSON endpoint https://www.wiamachine.com/api/public/series/detail (POST seriesSeq=4, productType=MC) that the series page renders; units are implied by the site's labels (mm, r/min, kW, N·m, m/min, kg). Brackets [] are options on the site. Spindle power/torque published as an unlabeled pair (first value placed in peak/other / max; second listed in notes). Catalogue PDF requires an applicant form (not used). Pairs: power 30/18.5 kW, torque 230/119 N·m. Pallet published as '2 - 400x400', load '2 - 400' (2 pallets, per-pallet load). Series feature text: ring-type magazine standard, 60T magazine max call 2.9 s, 'best-in-class' C-C 2.6 s (series claim, not per model), Ø50 mm ballscrews with shaft cooling. Site lists 'Spindle Drive Type = LM' (data-entry slip; built-in per feature text). Pallet change time not on current site; older maker-posted Komachine listing (HS5000 gen-I, X/Y/Z 850/700/750) gives 12 s direct-turn APC. Surprising: HS4000 II / HS5000 II travels, rpm, power and torque are identical to DN Solutions NHP 4000 / NHP 5000 on dn-solutions.com.
